# The Nature Conservancy

> A global conservation organization combining science, policy, and partnerships to create a world where people and nature thrive.

The Nature Conservancy (TNC) is an international nonprofit focused on tackling climate change, protecting biodiversity, and ensuring sustainable food and water systems. The organization operates across multiple regions including Latin America, Africa, and North America, leveraging conservation science and nature-based solutions to address global environmental challenges.

## Key Topics

- Climate change mitigation
- Nature-based solutions
- Biodiversity protection
- Water security
- Sustainable food systems
- Conservation science
- 2030 Goals
- 30x30 land protection
- Carbon reduction
- Regenerative agriculture
- Ocean conservation
- Freshwater protection
- Wildlife migration
- Conservation partnerships
- Evidence-based policy

## Strategic Priorities & Goals

- [TNC 2030 Goals](https://www.nature.org/en-us/what-we-do/our-priorities): TNC 2030 strategic goals addressing climate change and biodiversity loss
- [Climate Change Solutions](https://www.nature.org/en-us/what-we-do/our-priorities/tackle-climate-change): Nature-based climate change solutions and carbon reduction strategies
- [Ocean, Land & Freshwater Protection](https://www.nature.org/en-us/what-we-do/our-priorities/protect-water-and-land): Ocean, land and freshwater conservation efforts aligned with 30x30
- [Sustainable Food & Water Systems](https://www.nature.org/en-us/what-we-do/our-priorities/provide-food-and-water-sustainably): Sustainable food and water systems through regenerative agriculture

## Research, Data & Tools

- [Insights & Reports](https://www.nature.org/en-us/what-we-do/our-insights): Reports, tools and solutions on climate, water security and biodiversity
- [Data & Tools](https://www.nature.org/en-us/what-we-do/our-insights/data-and-tools): Conservation tools including Marxan, Blue Carbon Model and planning
- [Research Reports](https://www.nature.org/en-us/what-we-do/our-insights/reports): Downloadable research reports on climate, biodiversity and sustainability
- [Expert Perspectives](https://www.nature.org/en-us/what-we-do/our-insights/perspectives): Expert perspectives on conservation challenges and wildlife migration

## About The Nature Conservancy

- [Who We Are](https://www.nature.org/en-us/about-us/who-we-are): Overview of The Nature Conservancy's mission, vision and global impact
- [How We Work](https://www.nature.org/en-us/about-us/who-we-are/how-we-work): Organizational approach combining science, policy and private partnerships
- [Conservation Science Foundation](https://www.nature.org/en-us/about-us/who-we-are/our-science): Conservation science methodology and evidence-based research approach
- [Our People](https://www.nature.org/en-us/about-us/who-we-are/our-people): Leadership team, staff directory and conservation experts at TNC

## Global Presence

- [The Nature Conservancy Global](https://www.nature.org/en-us): Homepage for The Nature Conservancy global conservation organization
- [The Nature Conservancy Latin America](https://www.nature.org/es-us): Spanish-language homepage for The Nature Conservancy in Latin America

- [Accountability](https://www.nature.org/en-us/about-us/who-we-are/accountability): Transparency, financial reports and charity ratings for donor confidence
